heading: Short films
intro: Narrative shorts, most written, directed, and edited independently.

items.title: Opening Night
items.blurb: An awkward high school theater geek unexpectedly lands a lead role. She knows she must tell her best friend and braces for a fallout in their friendship, only to learn that her friend was never in it for the spotlight.

items.title: Red Herring
items.blurb: A college student wakes up covered in blood with no memory of the night before. As his investigation leads to his neighbor's missing cat, he fears the worst.

items.title: Interlude
items.blurb: An impressionistic black and white film exploring the passion and sorrow of a young couple.

items.title: Between Love and Walls
items.blurb: A young woman attempts to reconnect with her childhood friend before the friend packs her car and leaves forever.

items.title: Under The Apron
items.blurb: A no dialogue character sketch depicting a young man’s panicked and unsuccessful attempts to cook dinner for a girl.
